ValidationRule.description: Ensures required fields are not null for Card Dispute cases.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', ISPICKVAL(Dispute_Reason__c, "Don't recognise the transaction"), ISPICKVAL(Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c, 'No'), OR( ISBLANK(Description), OR( ISPICKVAL(Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c, 'NA') ), OR( ISPICKVAL(Has_The_Card_Been_Stopped__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Has_The_Card_Been_Stopped__c, 'NA') ), AND( ISPICKVAL(Is_The_Card_Lost_Stolen__c, 'No'), OR( ISPICKVAL(Card_In_Possession_During_Transaction__c,''), ISPICKVAL(Card_In_Possession_During_Transaction__c,'NA') ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: These fields are required: Description of Issue, Is The card Lost/Stolen, Card In Possession During Transaction, Has The Card Been Stopped.
